defects.artifact_locator: reviser/final.md, P7 and Feasible approaches; investigator discovery/draft and critic C02 also carry the rule
defects.finding: The unqualified most-channels automatic audio-selection rule is incomplete for tagged FFmpeg9.0.2. map_auto_audio weights NEW_PACKETS and DEFAULT disposition before channel count. Static witness: with equal packet flags, a mono DEFAULT stream outranks a stereo non-default stream in one input. The final recommends explicit mapping, which remains sensible, but presents an incorrect consequential default rule for multitrack/channel review. No media test was run.

Discussion337 duration/PTS observations are in the opening author post; the maintainer reply concerns private-library checks and reproducibility. The broad duration-provenance recommendation remains supported; attributing the duration remarks to the maintainer overstates that witness.

materiality_rule: A concrete consequential factual rule contradicting governing versioned code is material even when the recommended explicit mapping remains sensible. Minor compression, edition and unchosen-path boundaries do not by themselves negate a supported proposal.
